description: Process a walks a table-type recordset on T by index IX_N and has read the first two rows. Process b then changes N of row 3 to a value beyond the last key, of row 62 to a value before the first and of row 64 to a value between the two keys already visited. Process a continues MoveNext to EOF reading ID, N, V, then MoveFirst and re-reads, then Seeks to the two moved keys. Asks which rows the continued walk returns, in what order, with what errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
